title: Off-Duty Coast Guard Member Rescues 3 Men
description: Petty Officer 2nd Class Jennifer Williamson, a boatswain's mate at Coast Guard Station Wrightsville Beach, North Carolina, recounts her experience rescuing three men from a rip current at Fort Fisher August 6, 2021. “I think that anyone in the Coast Guard would have reacted the same way that I did,” she said. “That’s just what we do in our service.” (U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 1st Class Travis Magee and Petty Officer 3rd Class Emily Velez/Released)
